description: This file implements the 'git replay' builtin command which involves commit manipulation, reference updates, and rev walk logic within the Git version control system.

classes.name: ref_info
classes.description: Structure holding information about references involved in replay, including the target commit, positive and negative reference sets, and counts of ref expressions.

methods.name: const char * short_commit_name(struct repository * repo,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Returns a short unique abbreviation of a commit in a repository.

methods.name: struct:commit * peel_committish(struct repository * repo,const char * name,const char * mode)
methods.description: Resolves a name or identifier to a commit object within the repository.

methods.name: char * get_author(const char * message)
methods.description: Extracts the author header from a commit message.

methods.name: struct:commit * create_commit(struct repository * repo,struct tree * tree,struct commit * based_on,struct commit * parent)
methods.description: Creates a new commit object based on provided tree, parent, and message, with author info.

methods.name: void get_ref_information(struct repository * repo,struct rev_cmdline_info * cmd_info,struct ref_info * ref_info)
methods.description: Analyzes revision command line inputs to determine which references are affected and their resolution states.

methods.name: void set_up_replay_mode(struct repository * repo,struct rev_cmdline_info * cmd_info,const char * onto_name,char ** advance_name,struct commit ** onto,struct strset ** update_refs)
methods.description: Configures the replay operation based on command line parameters and repository state.

methods.name: struct:commit * mapped_commit(kh_oid_map_t * replayed_commits,struct commit * commit,struct commit * fallback)
methods.description: Retrieves the replayed version of a commit from the stored mapping or returns a fallback.

methods.name: struct:commit * pick_regular_commit(struct repository * repo,struct commit * pickme,kh_oid_map_t * replayed_commits,struct commit * onto,struct merge_options * merge_opt,struct merge_result * result)
methods.description: Chooses and replays a commit, performing a merge with the base, creating a new commit, and updating references.

methods.name: enum:ref_action_mode parse_ref_action_mode(const char * ref_action,const char * source)
methods.description: Parses the reference action mode string into enum.

methods.name: enum:ref_action_mode get_ref_action_mode(struct repository * repo,const char * ref_action)
methods.description: Determines the reference action mode from configuration or command line.

methods.name: int handle_ref_update(enum ref_action_mode mode,struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * refname,const struct object_id * new_oid,const struct object_id * old_oid,const char * reflog_msg,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Updates or prints the specified ref depending on the mode.

methods.name: int cmd_replay(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
